summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of ShadowQA autonomous debugging agent embedded in Lumen Supply Co. demo. Backend: 18/18 existing pytest suite + 20/20 new integration tests (backend_integration) — all green. Frontend flagship checkout flow: full loop OBSERVE→DIAGNOSE→VALIDATE→REPLAY→VERIFIED reached in ~18s, order-confirmation rendered, Undo restored payments.js. Frontend cart-promo flow: initial run classified fix as RISK MEDIUM (correct behavior; policy auto_low held; View Fix button surfaced with 97% confidence, root cause pinned to demo/lib/promo.js:12); second run same bug auto-applied (RISK LOW) and FIX VERIFIED with cart-discount-row and 3 checks passed. Inspector via status dot opens with all 5 tabs (timeline/graph/agent/health/memory), sqa-run-qa-btn present, 8 flow rows, Ctrl+Shift+Q toggles, close btn works. Jest suite: 3/3 suites, 7/7 tests pass. Demo bugs restored at end via reset_demo.sh (verified via grep).

issues: One product image (Ridge Split-Timber Hatchet) rendered as alt text placeholder rather than image — appears broken/missing asset while sibling product image loads fine. Minor asset/URL issue, not a functional blocker.

action_items: Investigate missing/broken image for product lum-04 (Ridge Split-Timber Hatchet) — appears to render alt text on Products page under Edge & Craft filter.

Cart bug (promo.js) risk classification varies between runs (LOW auto-applied vs MEDIUM manual). Not necessarily a bug (LLM-derived risk), but if the demo expects consistent auto-verify path, consider pinning risk based on file/rule signature instead of LLM heuristic.
critical_code_review_comments: reset_demo.sh reads MONGO_URL from .env via naive `cut -d= -f2 | tr -d '"'`: fragile if the value contains an `=` (e.g. auth db options) — consider `sed -E 's/^MONGO_URL=//'`.
Backend /api/shadowqa/workspace/file uses correct allow-list denying backend/.env, ../etc/passwd, and the SDK core.js — verified via parametrised test.
Overlay lives inside an open shadow root — good encapsulation; data-testids are consistent (sqa-*), making tests robust.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the specified critical flows (flagship checkout, cart promo, inspector, Jest); Store UX partially verified (products/filter/detail/orders/settings save/logout not all executed end-to-end due to session drop in one run)
